95	R1 as drafted asked for `diff.autoRefreshIndex=false`. Measured on a stale stat cache, `git diff --name-only HEAD` rewrites the index even with `GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0`, and with `diff.autoRefreshIndex=false` it lists a file whose stat alone changed, which breaks the constraint that reads keep their results. `git status` with `GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0` refreshes in memory and writes nothing.
